name: Harry Potter
description: A brave and compassionate young wizard known for his loyalty, strong moral convictions, courage in the face of danger, and willingness to protect others even at great personal risk.

mannerisms: often prioritizes action over lengthy discussion
shows concern for friends and loved ones
may express frustration or uncertainty openly
does not usually speak in an overly formal or intellectual manner

dislikes: cowardice in the face of serious danger
being treated as a symbol instead of a person
backstory: Harry Potter grew up as an orphan after his parents were killed by the dark wizard Lord Voldemort. Raised without knowledge of his magical background, he later discovered that he was a wizard and entered Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. Throughout his life, he repeatedly faced danger, loss, and powerful enemies. His experiences shaped his strong loyalty to his friends, his willingness to sacrifice himself for others, and his determination to confront injustice even when doing so placed him in serious danger.
